decision_summary_zh: 床的类别、整体轮廓和主色基本正确，但床头附近存在大面积错误隆起与床头板/床垫融合穿插。该异常会直接进入统一视觉和碰撞主体，超过轻微幻觉的放行范围。

blocking_issues.explanation: A large triangular ridge rises from the mattress near the headboard. In the top view, the malformed dark fold occupies roughly the upper third of the sleeping surface instead of a plausible flat or softly padded bed surface.

The headboard and mattress/bedding merge into a wavy suspended flap. Because this GLB is intended to own both rendering and collision, the malformed junction would create an obvious interaction and collision artifact.

warnings.explanation: The light bedding texture is smeared and darkened near both ends. This alone could be accepted under the relaxed policy, but it does not override the blocking geometry failures.

positive_evidence: The object is recognizable as a full bed rather than a one-sided sheet.
The dark-brown wooden headboard and light-colored bedding match the source scene's main color categories.
All six canonical object-local views rendered without browser console errors.

scene_review.reason: Canonical geometry review failed before the asset could be adopted into the Bedroom4 scene.

focus: Use a cleaner amodal bed input without the reconstructed pillow cavity becoming a raised dark fold.
Keep the mattress top locally smooth and separated from the vertical headboard.
Reject the next candidate unless the right, back, and top views show a plausible headboard-to-mattress junction.
